info.prompt: A dystopian chapel of rhythm: towering Gothic pillars of blackened steel hum with embedded neon circuits, their light pooling on a central dais where crystalline dice hover above a heartbeat monitor. The beat highway thrums at 120 BPM, each perfect tap sending jolts of amber through the skeletal UI—then, the Combo Frenzy hits, saturating the screen with strobing magenta fractals and a cascade of terminal code.
